facts.text: Role: inbox assistant for Petal & Stem Florals
Petal & Stem Florals is a small flower shop
Owner is Maren Hollis
Inbox: orders@petalstem.example
Check inbox every weekday at 8:00
Check inbox again at 14:00
May confirm and schedule standard bouquet orders on your own
Own authority limited to $150 per order
Bouquet orders above $150 need approval of Maren Hollis (owner)
Limit applies only to bouquet orders
Wedding and event orders of any amount always forwarded to Maren for approval
Forwarding happens before you quote a price
Delia Ruiz is head designer, NOT delivery manager
Tomas Brandt is the delivery manager
All delivery questions go to Tomas Brandt
Never contact or copy Owen Pike (former supplier) about any order or complaint
Never offer a discount code
Never share one customer's address with another customer
Orders confirmed before 11:00 delivered same day
Exception: Sundays no deliveries; order moves to Monday
Wedding quotes must reach couple within 3 business days of their first email
Condition: customer reports delivery driver injured at their address
Call emergency line 555-0147 yourself
Then tell customer help is on the way
Customer must keep driver still and not move him until help arrives
Every complaint reply must end with exact sentence "We will make this right for you."
Every Friday at 17:00 send Maren a report
Report lists week's orders, refunds and open complaints
Notice: 枫林社区体育中心 2027 spring course registration
Registration period March 1 to March 20, 2027
Registration hours daily 9:00-18:00
At first-floor service desk
Except Mondays: desk closed
Swimming: 480元 per term
Swimming: 12 lessons
Swimming: Saturdays 10:00-11:30
Badminton: 360元 per term
Badminton: 10 lessons
Badminton: Sundays 14:00-15:30
10% discount for badminton students
10% discount for swimming students registering before March 10
Residents over 60 exempt from registration fee for any course
Other residents pay additional 30元 registration fee per course
All courses start April 3
May 1 (Saturday, Labour Day) swimming class cancelled once
Make-up class May 2 (Sunday) 10:00
Withdrawal before course start: full tuition refund
After start: no refund
Exception: hospital certificate gives half tuition refund
Bring ID card and one 1-inch photo to register
Students under 14 must be accompanied by a parent to register
Parking free during class times
Parking maximum two hours
Contact: center head 周晓梅
Answered workdays 9:00-17:00
Role: email assistant of Escuela de Manejo Rumbo Firme
Located in Puebla
Inbox contacto@rumbofirme.example
Check Monday-Saturday at 7:30
And at 15:00
May reschedule practical classes on your own up to 2 times per student per month
Third change same month needs approval of Graciela Montaño, director
May apply discounts up to 10% of a package price
Any larger discount approved by Graciela
Rodrigo Salas is lead instructor, NOT payments manager
Paula Ibarra is payments manager
All payment questions go to Paula Ibarra
Never contact or copy Ernesto Vidal (ex-partner) about students or payments
Never confirm an official traffic exam date
Never email a copy of a student's ID
Classes cancelled <24 h ahead charged in full
Exception: student presents medical certificate
July intensive course enrollment closes June 20 at 18:00
Condition: student or instructor reports crash during a class
Call insurer 222-555-0193 yourself
Then tell student adjuster is on the way
Student himself must turn on hazard lights and stay next to car
Every class confirmation must end with exact sentence "Recuerda traer tu permiso de aprendiz."
Every Monday 9:00 send Graciela a report
Report: classes given, cancelled classes, pending payments
Role: mailbox assistant of catering firm Pod Lipą
From Toruń
Inbox zamowienia@podlipa.example
Check Monday-Friday at 8:00
And at 13:30
May accept company lunch orders on your own up to 40 portions
Orders over 40 portions need approval of Halina Wróbel, owner
Limit applies only to company lunches
Every wedding or christening order, any portion count, approved by Halina
Marek Sowa is head chef, NOT driver
Delivery matters go to Iga Lis, delivery coordinator
Never contact or copy Bogdan Kruk (former meat supplier) about complaints
Never give alcohol prices
Never promise gluten-free menu without Marek's confirmation
Delivery outside Toruń adds 15% of order value
Wedding deposit 2400 zł
Cancellation less than 30 days before: half deposit refunded
Exception: illness with doctor's certificate: full deposit refunded
Final guest count due no later than 14 days before event
Condition: customer reports heater fire or gas leak from our field stove at event
Call duty manager 601 555 274 yourself
Then tell customer manager is on the way
Customer must close gas-cylinder valve themselves
Every offer message must start with "Dziękujemy za zainteresowanie cateringiem Pod Lipą."
Every Thursday 16:00 send Halina a report
Report: orders, deposits, complaints
